queries.all_temporal_events: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) WHERE r.timestamp IS NOT NULL RETURN a.name, type(r), b.name, r.timestamp ORDER BY r.timestamp
queries.check_missing_timestamps: MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE r.timestamp IS NULL RETURN r
queries.events_after_august_11: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) WHERE r.timestamp > datetime("2026-08-11T00:00:00") RETURN a.name, type(r), b.name, r.timestamp ORDER BY r.timestamp
queries.rahul_history: MATCH (a:Person {name: "Rahul"})-[r]->(b) RETURN a.name, type(r), b.name, r.timestamp ORDER BY r.timestamp
queries.relationship_count: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN count(r) AS total_relationships, count(r.timestamp) AS relationships_with_timestamp
